te-cover.label: Share of Sunrisers Hyderabad's deliveries with a length tag, 2024–2026
te-cover.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
te-cover.query: SELECT c.length, CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mine, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM delivery_commentary c JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = c.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY c.length, mine
